description: EMA packet loss threshold boundary test vectors per spec/02-physical-link.md section 3.5. Per spec pseudocode: if nbr.ema_loss > 0.25: sf = min(12, sf + 1). Tests exact boundary behavior at 0.24, 0.25, and 0.26.
oracle_provenance: Independent calculation from spec pseudocode. EMA loss uses alpha=1/4 (diff >> 2). Threshold is strictly > 0.25 (not >=).
spec_reference: spec/02-physical-link.md section 3.5 pseudocode select_tx_sf() line: if nbr.ema_loss > 0.25: sf = min(12, sf + 1)

vectors.name: ema_loss_0.24_below_threshold
vectors.description: ema_loss=0.24: below threshold (0.25), no SF bump.

vectors.name: ema_loss_0.25_at_threshold_exactly
vectors.description: ema_loss=0.25: exactly at threshold. Spec uses > not >=, so no bump.

output.reason: 0.25 is NOT > 0.25 (equal is not greater), no SF adjustment

vectors.name: ema_loss_0.251_minimal_above
vectors.description: ema_loss=0.251: minimally above threshold, triggers SF bump.

vectors.name: ema_loss_0.50_high_loss
vectors.description: ema_loss=0.50: significant packet loss, SF bumped.

output.reason: High loss triggers SF+1 (not +2, single bump per call)

vectors.name: ema_loss_at_sf11_bump_to_12
vectors.description: ema_loss above threshold with SF11 baseline: bumps to SF12.

vectors.name: ema_loss_at_sf12_capped
vectors.description: ema_loss above threshold with SF12 baseline: capped at 12.

output.reason: ema_loss > 0.25 triggers bump attempt, but min(12, 12+1) = 12 (already at maximum)

vectors.note: sf_bumped=true because the condition was triggered, even though SF was already maxed

vectors.name: ema_loss_0.00_no_loss
vectors.description: ema_loss=0.00: perfect link, no SF bump.

vectors.name: ema_loss_with_good_snr_upgrade_blocked
vectors.description: Good SNR decrements SF, then high loss increments it back.

output.reason: Per spec pseudocode: SF-1 for good SNR (10->9), then SF+1 for high loss (9->10) = net 0 change but sf_bumped=true because loss condition triggered

vectors.notes: This tests the INTERACTION between SNR upgrade and loss downgrade
